# ModelFreeTemporalSwitch

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A framework that switches between temporal processing modes without requiring a pre-trained model, enabling transferable lightweight neuromorphic computation. It addresses the challenge of adapting neuromorphic systems to new tasks or environments without retraining, which is critical for scalable and practical in-network deployment.
